name: github-app-anakin
description: GitHub App: on a failed Actions workflow run, uses Anakin's agentic-search to research the failure and files a GitHub issue with findings; also exposes /anakin-search, /anakin-wire[-catalog|-run], /anakin-ai-visibility[-sources], /anakin-monitors, /anakin-monitor-changes, /anakin-sessions, /anakin-map, and /anakin-crawl slash commands in issue comments.
